subject: Operations
title: Process Mapping
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Process Mapping.

hook.text: A hospital mapped its ER admissions and found patients touched 17 departments for a simple broken arm.

buildup.text: Process mapping draws every step, decision, and handoff in a visual diagram anyone can read.

discovery.text: The map reveals redundant steps, unnecessary approvals, and points where errors creep in.

twist.text: People who work inside a process rarely see its full shape. The map gives them altitude.

climax.text: After mapping, the hospital cut ER admissions steps from 17 to 9—without losing any safety checks.

punchline.text: You can't improve a journey you haven't mapped.

quiz.question: What did the hospital discover by mapping its ER admissions process?
options: Patients touched 17 departments for a simple case
